story.vex: No one to blame means no one to stop me either. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every console now has one account, one person, and a trail that actually means something. Astro: "Fixed before it was needed, not after."

ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read console-audit.txt, then disable the shared shield-duty login so every action can be traced to one person.

1. type console-audit.txt
2. net user shift-shared /active:no

CONSOLE AUDIT — Shield Duty
------------------------------
Login 'shift-shared' is used by whichever cadet is on duty. Three different cadets have used it this week alone. No individual action on this console can currently be traced to a specific person.
